overview: A personal website and blog deployed on the Internet Computer. Supports dynamic content (About with info screens, Blog, Links), Internet Identity admin login, custom domain, and app store publishing with first-login admin bootstrap.
features: Admin login via Internet Identity with first-login bootstrap for clones
About section with info screens, rich text editor, image/video upload, heading alignment, and reorderable screens
Blog with emoji picker and formatted posts
Site statistics showing visit count and backend canister ID
Editable section names, page heading with font/color/background settings
